candidates.title: Prism: Cost-Efficient Multi-LLM Serving via GPU Memory Ballooning
candidates.reason: OSDI 2026 multi-LLM serving system using GPU memory ballooning/kvcached to unify spatial and temporal sharing. It is production-relevant, deployed at large scale, and directly connects virtualized elastic KV memory with load-aware placement and SLO-aware arbitration.

rejected_candidates.title: Towards Efficient and Practical GPU Multitasking in the Era of LLM
rejected_candidates.rejection_reason: Primarily a vision/position paper outlining GPU multitasking requirements and future resource-management directions rather than a standalone evaluated inference system.

discovery_stats.axis: related-work path from elastic KV memory to GPU memory ballooning / multi-LLM co-serving
discovery_stats.query_summary: Used the newly found elastic-KV path to inspect closely related virtualized GPU-memory work rather than repeating broad search. Prism emerged as a strong OSDI 2026 omission; the associated GPU-multitasking vision paper was rejected as non-system/position-oriented.
discovery_stats.next_axis_hint: Continue related-work path through Prism/kvcached to co-serving/harvesting systems, then independently inspect agent-serving related work.
